title: Lifted constant-realization scalar comparison
statement: For a scheme X, commutative rings B and C, a ring map q : B → C, and a cochain complex P of B-modules, derived constant realization of the coefficient-universe lift of P followed by derived scalar extension along the lifted map is isomorphic to the finite constant model over C of ordinary scalar extension of P along q. The constant functors preserve zero morphisms.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: derived extension cannot be replaced by ordinary termwise extension on an arbitrary non-K-flat complex. For Z→Z/2 and P=(Z/2)[0], derived tensor has a nonzero Tor_1 term while ordinary tensor does not. This false intermediate has been withdrawn. Its parent lem-weil-pbc-finite-model-derived-scalar-comparison is proved directly from the generic derived constant-realization comparison and a coefficient-lift-compatible K-flat resolution, without this assertion.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY and 0G7E require K-flat representatives for an ordinary tensor computation. False split withdrawn; replacement argument is in the unchanged parent theorem.
